scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/ui lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint && bun apps/web/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config apps/web/eslint.config.js research/gaze-3d/browser research/calibration
scripts.format: bun run --cwd packages/ui format && bun run --cwd apps/web format
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && tsc --noEmit --project research/tsconfig.json
